description:
Location: Hengelo, Netherlands 
 
 About Thales: 
 Thales designs highly advanced radar systems and optical sensors that are part of a complete and integrated defense system. The product portfolio ranges from small portable radars for applications such as border or object surveillance to complex four-dimensional radars capable of detecting small objects at distances from hundreds up to thousands of kilometers.
 Within the software department, the Sensor Processing group is responsible for software development of the optimal control and digital processing functions within the sensors. This work is carried out in multidisciplinary teams collaborating with specialists in system engineering, functional sensor design, and the design and implementation of real-time systems.
 
 About the job: 
 Within this Sensor Processing group, the complete radar software is developed. This includes various domains such as controlling the radar systems, organizing radar transmissions, and processing the digital information stream. The ultimate goal is to detect and classify specific objects, such as aircraft and drones, track them, and display them on an operator console.
 The software architecture is designed to be highly modular and supports the development of robust and evolutionary systems. Development takes place in Agile teams supported by a modern development toolchain. The teams themselves are responsible for the ongoing development and maintenance of the architecture, the toolchain, and the Agile process.
 
 About you: 
 Do you have a passion for technology and enjoy working on radar controls or complex algorithms?
 Then you might be the person we are looking for. We would like to offer you the opportunity to build a career in the international high-tech environment at Thales!
 The requirement is a completed HBO (higher professional education) or WO (university) degree in (technical) computer science or a related field. We expect substantial experience (5 years or more) with the programming languages C and C++ and with developing real-time software. Experience with other programming languages such as Java is a plus.
 You are creative, open-minded, and flexible, and you can operate effectively as a team player. Additionally, you are results-oriented, show initiative, and communicate clearly. A good command of both Dutch and English is necessary for successful function fulfillment.
 
 Screening Criteria: 
 •            Minimum of 5+ years of experience in C++ software development
 •            Experience with Real-Time Software development
 •            Proficiency with Linux operating systems
 •            Experience working as part of a large software development organization
 •            Effective team player
 •            Familiarity with build and deployment tools such as Jenkins, Artifactory, Maven
 •            Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent
 •            Reskilling is possible, but only if the candidate has prior real-time software experience
 •            Eligibility for VGB-B clearance and eligibility for Dutch Eyes-Only classification
 
 What's in it for you: 
 •            A challenging job in a great team within our high-tech, innovative work environment. Includes the freedom for initiative and good ideas.
 •            Room for personal and professional growth within our organization, for example in regards to technical, commercial or international skills.
 •            A comfortable work space in a modern environment, with a focus on flexibility and the right work/life balance.
 •            You can usually work where and when you want, to be able to do your work as well and efficiently as possible. Within Thales we implement hybrid working, where you can, for example, work from home two days a week if your role allows it.
 •            A good salary, fitting travel allowance, and the ability to personalize your employment conditions. For instance, you can trade days off for our bicycle plan or company fitness.
 •            40 days paid-time-off per year.
 
 Interested? 
 Apply now! Click on the button below to upload your profile and show your interest.
 To ensure that we are a good match, we may ask you to participate in an assessment.
 A government clearance will be requested as part of standard Thales procedures.
 
 Diversity Statement 
 We actively support a working pattern that suits your lifestyle and helps you reach your ambitions. That means that equal opportunities, inclusion and an informal culture are integral to our success. It also means that your well-being and happiness matter to us! That’s why we offer you the flexibility to do what’s important to you; whether that’s part time hours, job sharing, remote working, or the ability to flex your start and finish times.
 
 Security Requirements 
 In line with Thales' Baseline Security requirements, candidates will be asked to provide evidence of identity, eligibility to work in The Netherlands and employment and/or education history. This vacancy requires a security clearance which can require further evidence to be provided. For further details of the evidence required to apply for security clearance please refer to the General Intelligence and Security Service.
